brief: Bond repair for damaged hair. Everyone should be using it lol. Salon and retail.

profile.business_summary: A hair care brand offering bond repair treatments for damaged hair, distributed through both salon and retail channels.

relevant_tags.why: This is the core product category.
Haircare is a major subcategory of beauty.
Adjacent interest; consumers who visit spas or salons are highly likely to purchase professional-grade bond repair.
High cross-sell affinity between skincare buyers and premium haircare buyers.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.61-$0.88 per click (median $0.72), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.

allocations.rationale: market price $0.58-$0.79 (median $0.66); bidding $0.48 wins ~5% of page views, paying ~$0.44 per click (second price); host also sells this kind of product: confirm it allows competing brands
